title: diphaca verrucosa
intro: Diphaca verrucosa, commonly known as the rough barked diphaca, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polygalaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, providing various health benefits such as aiding in the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Diphaca verrucosa include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
